# COMPANY REVIEWS [italic]Anonymous reviews by people who work there, or did. Indentured does not edit reviews. Some employers do.[/italic]
## WEYLAND-YUTANI (3.9 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] good pay, good pension, good everything, very good. [bold]Cons:[/bold] none. [color=#5A6A80]Posted from a Weyland-Yutani terminal at 09:00 sharp by an account called HappyEmployee.[/color] - [bold]Pros:[/bold] they build better worlds. [bold]Cons:[/bold] they do not say who for. - [bold]Pros:[/bold] the coffee. [bold]Cons:[/bold] I asked about a project I was not cleared for and was moved to a colony I had never heard of. I like it here. The coffee is not as good.
## SEEGSON (2.8 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] relaxed atmosphere, friendly staff, cheap terminals. [bold]Cons:[/bold] the terminals. - [bold]Pros:[/bold] I got to work with Working Joes every day. [bold]Cons:[/bold] see pros. - [bold]Pros:[/bold] they gave me a station to look after. [bold]Cons:[/bold] they will not tell me where it went.
## HYPERDYNE SYSTEMS (4.2 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] clean labs, smart colleagues. [bold]Cons:[/bold] some of the smart colleagues are not people, and they are much better at their jobs than me, and they are very kind about it.
## UNITED STATES COLONIAL MARINE CORPS (4.5 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] travel, comradeship, three meals a day, a rifle. [bold]Cons:[/bold] the travel is in a tube, the meals are in a pouch and the places you travel to are on fire. - [bold]Pros:[/bold] best years of my life. [bold]Cons:[/bold] I remember almost nothing about the last one, and the Corps says that is normal.
## LASALLE BIONATIONAL (3.5 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] I help people. [bold]Cons:[/bold] I mostly help people fill out forms about why they need help.
## SPACEGPT INC. (1 OUT OF 5) - [bold]Pros:[/bold] small team, flexible hours. [bold]Cons:[/bold] the server room. I will not go back to the server room. Do not ask me to go back to the server room.
